focus_areas: Sharpness and geometric regularity of the spark wheel teeth
Physical separation and contact shadows between the metal wind guard and the plastic body

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the spark wheel. In AI images, repetitive mechanical textures like gear teeth often degrade into smooth blobs. Verify if the teeth are distinct individual elements. Also, check the metal shield: does it look like a separate piece attached to the plastic, or does it morph out of the plastic? Real lighters have a distinct crimp or press-fit line there.
